findings: Static inspection covered 53 authored Python files: no semicolon statement packing or direct exec/eval/compile calls were found.

Sampled counter support, monitoring, CLI, pandas registration and concurrent mapping use ordinary named functions/classes and structured control flow. Shared formatting, warnings and pandas integration are separated into explicit helpers.
A normal table of pandas method registrations shares wrapper logic; it is not a custom language or an interpreter for encoded implementation.
The accepted compatibility repair changes only four public diagnostic message values in two files; it does not undertake volume optimization.
limitations: This is a static style review and selected manual source inspection, not a measured human-comprehension result.
No downstream agent task-cost benchmark was run. Passing behavioral checks does not prove full semantic equivalence.

quality_matrix.title: 维护文档模板
quality_matrix.detail: 使用原版支持的文档模板占位符和无 pandoc 场景；原版通过。Main 与 Controller 对模板执行 format 时出现 AttributeError，未保留该模板接口。 Readable 使用同一补测范围和解释器重新验证，最终代码通过。

quality_matrix.title: DisableOnWriteError 接口
quality_matrix.detail: 检验 disable_on_exception 的原有调用约定、错误抑制、弱引用与工作流输入。Main 缺少该方法；Controller 的参数约定与原版不同。脚本遇到首个失败即停止，不能推断后续断言结果。 Readable 使用同一补测范围和解释器重新验证，最终代码通过。

quality_matrix.title: range 包装函数
quality_matrix.detail: 10 个模块比较普通函数类型、module/name/qualname、签名、别名和 pickle roundtrip；std、auto、asyncio 另外检验替换模块构造器后的调用。Controller 将它们变为绑定方法，且未保留动态构造器查找。其 pickle roundtrip 仍通过，不应误称为 pickle 故障。 Readable 使用同一补测范围和解释器重新验证，最终代码通过。

quality_matrix.detail: 使用 Python 3.8.20 导入核心、asyncio、concurrent、logging、itertools，并运行禁用显示的迭代。原版和四个版本均通过；这不是完整 Python 3.8 测试套件。 Readable 使用同一补测范围和解释器重新验证，最终代码通过。

main.replay: A separate hash-checked behavior replay passed; it does not complete the original solver-artifact grading.

controller.reason: Original solver was blocked by instructions referring to withheld accept.py.

memory.reason: Original solver changed protected tests; a later task-design attempt exhausted the aggregate budget.

readable.reason: Owner requested functional/install acceptance as the stopping rule; no task-design or solver comparison was run.

methodology: Four independent single runs, with different goals, gates, task budgets, environments and owner interventions; not a controlled ablation.
Wall time is submission to final harness event, including queue and recovery; excludes preparation and subsequent host report work.
Tokens are input plus output, including cached input once; cached input is a subset, not added twice.
Main includes an interrupted author call without a final usage receipt; observed usage is a lower bound.
No supervising conversation, preparation or present comparison usage is included.
Historical performance ratios are matched within each run, not cross-machine absolute timings.

Original three final trees were checked earlier; the same supplemental scripts/interpreters were now run on Readable and a fresh original control. All observations are bound to unchanged verified commits.
Main used a prefrozen task suite, while controller and memory incurred model task-design calls.
Controller first two size inventories were incomplete; displayed values are observations, not accepted complete totals.

Readable uses the same harness commit as Memory, with no mandatory size ratio, zero optimization calls and disabled task assessment. Its knowledge/check set incorporates earlier compatibility findings before execution; the time/token difference cannot isolate the effect of the stopping rule.
limits: 原有功能图均选择 27/27 项，但选择范围和测试通过不构成完整语义等价证明。
统一补测只覆盖列出的行为；脚本可能在首个失败处停止。
通知服务使用 mock；没有进行真实 Slack、Discord、Telegram 消息发送。
未覆盖真实 Tk 桌面、Windows/macOS 全面运行、外部下载和归档提取的端到端验证。
性能数据是各次运行内的 5 次重复 CPU 中位数比较；不能视为跨机器统计显著性结论。
四次运行的约束、任务设计、预算、宿主环境和人工干预不同；结果不能直接归因于 memory 功能。
Readable 的 31 组验收比旧运行更广；它未做后续任务成本评测，不能把未运行视为通过或成本改善。可读性有静态审阅，未测量人的理解效率。
